It's also worth noting that the repetition of these experiences can create a sense of continuity and tradition, which can be a powerful source of comfort and strength. As you go through the same rituals and practices year after year, you may find that you're able to tap into a deeper sense of purpose and meaning, and that these experiences become an integral part of your identity and sense of self. Overall, I believe that going through the same experiences every year can indeed change how someone thinks about what they owe others, and can help them develop a greater sense of empathy, compassion, and understanding for those around them.
